issues.reason: The obliques rule is explicit that the head is the preposition actually used — 'in stays `In`; `During` renders only the word during' — so the surface 'in Thursday morning trading' takes the preposition-named oblique `(In sk_rise_1 sk_trading_1)`.

*Names and casing* requires a multi-word name's kind to be stated in one ordinary type atom 'whether the kind word sits inside the name or beside it' (the Kestrel River → `(Member kestrel_river river)`), and the parse emits only the `Name` fact.

*Measures & units* states that 'a measure on a PLURAL subject is the group AGGREGATE … it does NOT distribute to each member', so `(Measure sk_shares_1 price 27.43 dollar)` asserts the whole block of Allegiant shares is worth $27.43, which is false — the figure is per share.

`Measure` puts a value on a dimension OF its first argument ('The box weighs 5 kg' → `(Measure sk_box_1 weight 5 kilogram)`), so `(Measure sk_rise_1 price 4 dollar)` says the rise event costs $4 — false, since $4 is the size of the change, not a price of anything.

Two `Measure` atoms on the same entity and the same `price` scale return contradictory rows to one `(Measure sk_rise_1 price $n $u)` binding, and the appositive-'or' restatement has no licensed encoding — nor is `percent` one of the lemmatized units, percentages being carried only by `(Fraction p 100)` inside `ProportionOf`.

gaps_confirmed: a measured delta on a scalar-change verb ('rose $4', 'to $27.43') — `MoreBy` is comparative-only and `BeforeBy` temporal-only, so neither the increment nor the resulting value has a licensed encoding
reformulative/appositive 'or' ('$4, or 17.2 percent') restating one quantity in another unit rather than disjoining — `(Or …)` would be wrong and nothing else is offered
a proper-noun modifier on a common noun ('Allegiant shares') — neither the multi-word-name rule nor the possessor/part 'car engine' rule squarely covers a company name naming the issuer
new_gaps: a PER-UNIT value of a plural: because a measure on a plural reads as the group aggregate and the per-member distribution rule needs an explicit universal, a per-share price has no licensed carrier at all
a percentage as a measure unit: `(Fraction p 100)` exists only in `ProportionOf`'s level slot, so a relative magnitude on a `Measure` cannot be expressed
repair_summary: Replaced `(During sk_rise_1 sk_trading_1)` with the surface-preposition oblique `(In sk_rise_1 sk_trading_1)`; added the missing kind atoms `(Member nasdaq_stock_market stock_market)` and its mandatory compound genus `(Inheritance stock_market market)`; removed `(Past (Measure sk_shares_1 price 27.43 dollar))` as a false group-aggregate price; removed `(Measure sk_rise_1 price 4 dollar)` as a price predicated of an event; removed `(Measure sk_rise_1 price 17.2 percent)` as a colliding same-scale restatement with an unlicensed unit.
notes: All three numeric figures are lost because the delta/resulting-value construction has no licensed encoding and the brief directs removal over invention — this is the single largest gap the record surfaces, and financial market text will hit it constantly. `(Possession sk_shares_1 allegiant)`, the `Patient` on the intransitive rise, and `(Location sk_trading_1 …)` for the event-attached 'on' are left untouched.
